metadata.name: Burn Away
metadata.description: A page transition that burns: click a real HTML article and it chars and burns open onto a live landing page underneath, with a glowing rim, embers and smoke, then burns back. Uses Chrome 157's HTML-in-Canvas; other browsers crossfade the plain HTML pages. More at kit.neebarp.com
